goal: Test the Prime candidate as a compositional foundation

call_time_choice.observation: Ordered outcome occurrences and per-branch effect histories, with cell identities related by ObservationRel
limits: First-order equation heads rather than arbitrary higher-order application
de Bruijn argument binding rather than named two-way crossings
A fixed program during each run
No external transactional world effects in this source profile

named_scope.target_execution: Mettapedia.GSLT.LanguageDef.TemplateScope.runDir over progLF/elabLFFormAt of explicit scope translation
named_scope.observation: The whole optional ordered result list, each term and final ground store, at the same fuel/path/input store
limits: Ground-store matcher cannot represent an arbitrary alias between distinct unbound names
Both matching directions remain explicit parameters
Not composed with the call-time-choice heap machine

finite_scoped_search.target_execution: Mettapedia.Machines.Cursor.advance with the actual bounded cursor client
finite_scoped_search.observation: Selected ordered occurrences, world at the pause, and actual live source continuation; an exhausted cursor decodes to stopAnswers
limits: Finite source plans with total primitive actions
One pull may perform unbounded internal source work relative to the poll counter
Native disposal/cancellation and C lifetime correctness are not asserted

recorded_scoped_need.observation: Exact completed branch world and outcome; ordered whole-frontier comparison requires reference completion.
limits: The smaller ScopedNeed profile is not the first-class PolarizedNeed syntax.
Depth-first execution can retain and starve a later terminating alternative.
Named crossings, open stores and irreversible effects are not joined by this theorem.
A ground binding store cannot preserve the full family of future assignments satisfying an unresolved equality X=Y.

polarized_logical_tells.observation: Identical completed outcome and full branch world, with a joint solution of chronological logical tells; ordered finite terminal-state occurrences equal the original list filtered by final consistency.
polarized_logical_tells.checker: Existing total first-order unifier in the explicit FirstOrderProfile; generic comparison requires a sound and complete checker.
limits: Existing emitted labels carry explicit logical identities; source-bound equation expressions and fresh logical-binder elaboration remain open.
No prefix-sensitive asks or irreversible host effects are interpreted by this logical-tell profile.
This is not a compiler into physical CMR firings or a default native formation/conversion policy.
An incomplete or paused solver cannot be interpreted as inconsistent.

theorem_contract_native_map.contract: Independent source and target contexts, with the hole variable map accounting for case binders and prior arguments; includes quote/activation compilation without assuming semantic replacement of stored code.
Declared parallel communication and reflection profiles, one shared post-store model; name equality and process reduction remain distinct.
Compute each original cut from event deltas; changing checking enumeration is separate from reordering actual execution.
A typed registry binds names to actual bodies; retain primitive prerequisites, guards and situated send rights. Provenance is not installation authority.
One closed ordered queue-state occurrence, a separately implemented saved-prefix scan, exact old queue identity and a consistent frame.

Complete region images include exactly the retained frame; append-only plans retain physical prefix identity. Reservation checks physical layout as well as logical token. Images own storage but acquire no logical authority sidecars. Counted retirement capacity is prepared per universe under collection inhibition. Each transfer is whole or unchanged; validation stays current across the full publication interval.

An owned immutable checkpoint selects the actual checking history. Current theory occurrence, source observations and facets are validated before publishing an owned proof and reply. The checked-sequent consumer validates the authentic theorem under both recorded and current histories, with explicit ID/theory argument crossings. Hypotheses are retained.
Declared observation retention is separate from C lifetime. Unknown owners, pending readers, cancellation and captured prefixes require their actual ownership contracts.

Construct both actual paths, with an explicit nonidentity fresh-name exchange fixing original captures. Preserve all rows, equations, templates, occupied scopes and retained-root multiplicity. Empty incoming equations and no take/read/tell/guard ports are explicit restrictions.

theorem_contract_native_map.boundary: explicit binding permissions and joint observations
theorem_contract_native_map.contract: Explicit grants are separated from the transitive old equation component of protected observations. One model preserves the whole joint caller vector. Guard support includes live-row variables and captured schema names. Sufficient permission checks do not claim complete acceptance or literal equality of solver representations.
Every recorded completed branch has an independent natural derivation; a terminating branch alone does not establish termination or fair exploration of all siblings.

theorem_contract_native_map.boundary: first-class computations with persistent logical tells
theorem_contract_native_map.contract: Use actual polarized Need successors, rejecting an inconsistent store before scheduling its continuation. The proof derives all intermediate consistency from the final joint model. Retain captured thunks, shared producer identity, branch worlds and surviving ordered duplicates.

Construct both actual contextual firing paths under the original occurrence independence condition. Repeated reads may share a row; takes consume real occurrences. Unequal port counts use explicit scope maps. The complete joint equation list is preserved by permutation. Selected template views are rigid and incoming equations rigid-reflexive; nontrivial unification, tells and guards remain outside this theorem.

theorem_contract_native_map.boundary: per-use logical instantiation through actual execution
theorem_contract_native_map.contract: Explicit activation maps fresh private logical labels and fixes intentional captures throughout code, captured values, closures, heaps, cached outcomes and effects. Replay preserves successor indices and has no invention from the mapped image. Joint actual histories require per-use solutions agreeing on shared captures. Fresh scopes are supplied; automatic allocation, dynamic equation expressions and named crossing compilation remain open.

theorem_contract_native_map.boundary: native headed candidate retrieval after append
theorem_contract_native_map.contract: Reuse a stored prefix only with equal universe identity, storage epoch and prefix epoch, no marked storage or outstanding pins during catch-up, and a valid source length. Index the suffix before advancing the ceiling. Preserve keyed, open-head and whole-row-variable postings, authored arity, occurrence order and duplicate positions. Repeated-variable queries still use canonical matching. Initial construction, other query shapes and whole-workflow cost correspondence remain explicit obligations.

unclosed_obligations: One complete source semantics joining named crossings, shared demand, higher-order application, external effects and revision-sensitive resumption.
Actual reordered heterogeneous contextual executions with nontrivial unification, tells, original guard cuts and general solver-helper-frame transport; rigid selected-input swaps are proved.
Source-to-native C correspondence for the joined service, including complete dependencies, binding authority and ownership.
Reactive source/notification join, general cancellation/reclamation and stated fairness assumptions.
Locality and cost of a publisher beyond the serialized whole-touched-bag reference.
assessment: Qualified component comparisons and executable native experiments support continued testing; they do not establish whole-Prime compositional adequacy.
